notes.title: V1.41 - Bug Fixes & Experience Improvements
notes.notes:
Experience Improvements:
Press X to summon your current style scroll and hold it to view
Endless Mode exit changed to holding B for 3 seconds
Store books now use a copper coin icon instead of a currency symbol
Persistent scabbard feature changed to toggle on re-grab

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where swords on enemies could not be picked up manually
Fixed a visual mismatch when picking up the lobby scabbard with the dominant hand
Fixed an issue where “Spirit Infinite” had no cooldown
Fixed a bug where Instant Slash and Draw Slash might fail to properly complete the first-stage cooldown
Fixed incorrect positioning of skill icons

notes.title: Version 1.32: Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where Yi’s Assistance cooldown did not decrease when the scabbard was not being held.
Fixed a bug where Boss 2 could fall underground and die during a phase transition.
Fixed a bug where Boss 3 could remain in Phase 1 permanently.
Fixed a bug where Boss 3 had abnormally high HP in Phase 2.

notes.title: V1.31 bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed: Bug where hand position was incorrect when grabbing the Dragon Sword in reverse grip.
Fixed: Bug where both hands would enlarge when grabbing the Dragon Sword with both hands.
Fixed: Bug where UI elements were flipped in left-handed mode.
Fixed: Bug where some objects had incorrect grab positions in left-handed mode.
Fixed: Bug where Thunderstorm from the Thunder Sword could trigger when opening chests.
Fixed: Bug where the final boss’s flying swords would not disappear if interrupted.
Fixed: Bug where the final boss could become invincible.
